verdict.rationale: Termius documents SSH connections (termius-docs-35) and states it can generate Ed25519, ECDSA, and RSA keys (termius-docs-27). Its docs also cover passphrase-protected keys stored in a Keychain that hosts reference (termius-docs-12, termius-docs-3), importing existing ~/.ssh key files (termius-docs-16), and exporting public keys to authorized_keys (termius-docs-48). Community users confirm everyday SSH access to their servers (termius-comm-2, termius-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of authenticating with each specific key type (Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA).
